about: The white hart's walk: four poses of the body's own Walk (a four-beat walk keyed on the leg targets: hind left, fore left, hind right, fore right), side-on, down and up, at a WANDER pace of 900 ms a tile (a placeholder; the hunting rules set the real pace). The foot-slide limit is the wolf's 2 px for a quadruped's four-pose loop (DECISIONS 2026-10-29).
